Fix the train 5 Opus blocker: the Hive dashboard still renders a dollar amount, and the Command Center snapshot API forwards spend. The board must carry no money in browser output (no usd/spend/cost values), and the old classic board must stay reachable from the Cockpit too. Tests first where behavior changes.

1) tools/command-center-snapshot.mjs: remove the per-project `spendUsd` card field (the `Spend` field built from p.spend.usd / p.cost.allUsd) and the machine `stats.spendUsd` (built from machine.cost.allUsd). Remove the now-unused money plumbing; keep every other field and behavior. The API must not contain usd/spend/cost keys or values.

2) tools/watch-assets/hive-panels.js: remove the `spend recorded` kvRow, the `view.spend` mapping and every dollar construction, including `String.fromCharCode(36)` (it is an obfuscated dollar and a blocker). Replace that stat with a non-money value already present (e.g. done in 24h, jobs, or a muted 'spend tracked' with no value) or remove the row; keep the panel layout/density. No '$', no fromCharCode(36), no hidden money.

3) tools/watch-assets/cc-cockpit-mount.js: the Cockpit's Classic tab still links to '/', which now serves the Command Center. Point it at '/classic' with the same search string as the Hive Classic tab, so the old board is reachable from both pages.

4) tests/board-no-money.test.mjs: extend the browser source scan with a forbidden `String.fromCharCode(36)` pattern (label 'runtime dollar') so this class cannot come back.

5) tests/command-center-hive.test.mjs: drop the spend / spendUsd / fromCharCode expectations from the Hive dashboard tests so they match the new no-money panel (keep the rest of the test behavior).

6) tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs: with a fixture that carries machine.cost.allUsd and project spend.usd, assert the /api/command-center and /api/command-center/project bodies contain no 'usd', 'spend' or 'cost' keys and no dollar values, and assert the Cockpit Classic tab href is /classic.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/board-no-money.test.mjs tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs tests/command-center-hive-panels.test.mjs tests/cc-cockpit-mount.test.mjs tests/cc-hive-mount.test.mjs tests/watch-assets.test.mjs tests/command-center-hive.test.mjs tests/command-center-cockpit.test.mjs -> all pass. Report counts.
